summary: Tested Parent Dashboard 'My Facilitation Requests' feature and Methodology PDF handout. Seeded 4 professional-requests (info/decline/conflict/prepare) and verified parent dashboard shows correct status labels and messages per spec. Backend test_methodology_pdf.py passes (1/1). Methodology page has methodology-pdf-link and methodology-handout-link both pointing to /api/methodology/pdf; PDF endpoint returns 1-page application/pdf with correct filename. One design regression: at 390px width the /methodology header overflows the viewport by 83px because the Copy link button (Copy link, 104px) plus PDF + logo + Home don't fit in a single non-wrapping flex row.

issues: Header overflows viewport by 83px (headerScrollWidth=473 vs viewport=390). Cause: right-side action group [PDF] + [Copy link] (104px) is not wrappable and combined with Home link + logo overflows. Consider hiding 'Copy link' text on mobile (icon-only) or hiding methodology-share-btn on mobile like the Print button, or allow the right group to wrap (flex-wrap).

action_items: Fix mobile header overflow on /methodology at 390px (hide Copy link label on mobile or allow wrap). All other flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Methodology.jsx header uses `flex gap-2` without flex-wrap and only hides the Print button on mobile. On 390px viewport the Copy link + PDF buttons still push the row 83px past the viewport edge. Prefer `hidden sm:inline-flex` on the share button (or icon-only on small) to match the Print pattern.
ParentRequestStatus.jsx correctly filters out conflict_reported events from the shown lastMessage so private conflict notes are never leaked to the parent — verified end-to-end. Good.

Conflict notes are correctly hidden from the parent. Pro dashboard still renders pro-requests-section. parent-requests-section is NOT rendered for professional or admin users (verified via Dashboard.jsx `{!isPro && <ParentRequestStatus .../>}`).
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow RCA: /app/frontend/src/pages/Methodology.jsx header (lines ~36-48) uses `flex items-center justify-between gap-4` with a right-side `<div class="flex gap-2">` containing [Download PDF] + [Copy link] + [Print (hidden sm:)]. At 390px the visible children (Home link ~67px, logo, PDF button ~73px, Copy link button ~104px) plus padding sum to 473px, causing 83px horizontal overflow. Mitigation: make methodology-share-btn `hidden sm:inline-flex` (mirroring the Print button) OR change the label to icon-only on small viewports OR add `flex-wrap` to the outer header row.
